tasks.label: Save my work
tasks.command: git add -A && (git commit -m "Work saved $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" || true) && git push

tasks.label: Restart my form
tasks.command: pkill -f vite || true; nohup npm run dev > /tmp/form.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; tail -n 5 /tmp/form.log

tasks.label: Reset EHRbase data (deletes templates, EHRs, compositions)
tasks.command: P=$(docker ps --filter name=ehrbase- --format '{{.Label "com.docker.compose.project"}}' | head -1) && docker compose -p "$P" -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml rm -sf ehrbase postgres && docker volume rm "${P}_db_data" && docker compose -p "$P" -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml up -d ehrbase postgres && bash .devcontainer/wait-for-ehrbase.sh
